description:
RE-TESTED at main a3a9761d1 (2026-09-02). This ticket originally held
three pre-existing parity/lowering bugs from the fz-kdt.111 refutation
(probes in session scratchpad k111/probes/). Two are FIXED by the
mailbox family (fz-kdt.130/152/155) and fz-kdt.127 and are struck here:
  (1) Enum.map over a LIST OF CLOSURES (p3_list_of_closures.fz): now
      [12, 20] / [] on interp and JIT (was interp unreachable_control).
  (2) A closure stored as a MAP VALUE (q3.fz): now [] / true on interp
      and JIT (was JIT/AOT abort in _fz_ref_load_int).
ONE remains, and it got WORSE (was native-only):
  (3) Two closures joined through an `if`, then passed to Enum.drop_while
      (q4.fz):

        fn pick(b, f, g) do
          if b do f else g end
        end
        fn main() do
          a = fn(x) -> x > 0 end
          b = fn(x) -> x < 0 end
          h = pick(true, a, b)
          dbg(Enum.drop_while([], h))          # means []
          dbg(Enum.drop_while([1, 2, 3], h))   # means []
        end

      interp: 'backend value 1 is unbound'; JIT/AOT:
      error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan] native executable lowering
      failed for index 5. Both doors, both calls.

The shape is a callable UNION reaching a forwarder-hosted HOF surface:
pick/3 returns closure[a] | closure[b] (an if-join, not a case on a
runtime value), so drop_while's wrapper lambda is constructed over a
union-typed capture. Under fz-kdt.127.1 that construction is one
CallableId over a union capture type (containment admission handles it
at dispatch); the failure is upstream at lowering: a backend value left
unbound in the construction/transport of the union-capture closure.
Compare fixtures2/behavior/callable_union_capture_containment.fz (a
union-typed capture chosen by a `case` on a MAILBOX value: green on all
doors) -- the difference is the if-join of two closure LITERALS in one
body, which is fz-kdt.107/108's joined-callable-at-a-dispatch-surface
family. Triage there first; red-first three-door fixture with the two
lines above as the Elixir oracle.
title: Two closures joined through an if, then passed to Enum.drop_while: fails on all three doors (interp 'backend value 1 is unbound'; native lowering fails)
